CventClientCredential.title: Cvent Client
CventClientCredential.x-credential-instructions: Create a Cvent application in the developer portal, associate the required API scopes, and paste its client ID and client secret. NoClick obtains a short-lived access token using the client credentials grant. This method uses the North America API region.

payload.description:
This endpoint supports both the invite and the ability to push registered attendees into Cvent.
There are some slight differences in how you use each path.

**Invite**

Fields supported for invite:
* event.id *(required)*
* contact.id *(required)*
* invitationList.id

**Note:** Up to 100 attendees can be invited per call. Sending a *status* of `No Response` will invite the attendee.

**Register**

* All fields are supported for register.
* admissionItem.id *(required)*

**Note:** When sending registration, one attendee per call is supported. Sending a status of `Accepted` will register the attendee.
 See the Cvent REST API reference for all fields. Send the complete intended record for updates.

CventOAuthCredential.title: Cvent OAuth
CventOAuthCredential.x-credential-instructions: Sign in as a Cvent planner administrator with a North America account. Developer users must use client credentials. The registered application must have the requested scopes, including account users read for the connection label. A manually supplied access token works until it expires; supply a refresh token and expiry to refresh it.

ScheduleConfig.description:
Schedule configuration from the frontend widget.
Fields accept Union[int, str] to support drag-and-drop references like
{{nodeId.values.field}} which get resolved at configuration time.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to run on (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday); empty = every day. Supported for seconds/minutes/hours intervals and daily schedules.
daysOfWeek.title: Daysofweek

windowStart.description: Part-of-day start as 24-hour "HH:MM" in the schedule timezone (e.g. "09:00"). Set together with windowEnd; interval frequencies only.
windowStart.title: Windowstart

windowEnd.description: Part-of-day end as 24-hour "HH:MM", inclusive — a run landing exactly on it fires (e.g. "18:00" runs the 6:00 PM tick).
windowEnd.title: Windowend

monthDayStart.description: Part-of-month start day (1-31), inclusive. Set together with monthDayEnd; a start after the end wraps around month end (25→5 = the 25th through the 5th).
monthDayStart.title: Monthdaystart

monthStart.description: Part-of-year start month (1=January … 12=December), inclusive. Set together with monthEnd; a start after the end wraps around the new year (11→2 = November through February).
monthStart.title: Monthstart
